tool_input.prompt: Latest React version and release date; list of versions

tool_result_content:
**Latest version:** React **19.3**, released **September 9, 2026** (`v19.3.0`). The docs at [react.dev](https://react.dev) cover this version. I can only confirm the date from this page, not independently.

**Documentation archives**, by major version:

| Version | Docs location |
|---|---|
| 19 (latest) | [react.dev](https://react.dev) |
| 18 | [18.react.dev](https://18.react.dev) |
| 17 | [17.react.dev](https://17.react.dev) |

The docs are updated within each major version and aren't published per minor or patch release. Versions older than React 15 are covered at [15.react.dev](https://15.react.dev). React 17 and below are hosted on legacy sites.

**Recent React 19 releases** (newest first):
- v19.3.0 (September 9, 2026)

- v19.2.5 (March 2026)

The full changelog, including React 18 and earlier releases, is in the [CHANGELOG on GitHub](https://github.com/react/react/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
